name: Celica pack (ZZT230/231)
description: Fusebox, specifications, checklist and the factory service manual for the seventh-generation Toyota Celica.

provenance.manual: Toyota RM744U1/U2 - 2000 Celica (ZZT230/231) repair manual, vols 1 and 2
provenance.caveat: US-market 2000 manual. Mechanicals carry over to a 2003 UK facelift T-Sport; body electrical, combination meter and some trim do not.
provenance.wiringDiagrams: Wiring diagrams are a separate publication (EW0399U) and are NOT in this manual.
provenance.textLayer: Page text comes from the PDF's own text layer, whose character map is damaged. Words are often mangled. Use it to find a page, then read the figure.

staticNote: This is a static export. Every route below is a file, and also works with a .json suffix. Free-text search (/api/manual/search) and the wheel calculator (/api/wheel) compute per request and are only available from tools/serve.py.
figures: Figure paths in these files are relative to the site root, e.g. assets/fig/p1939.png. Resolve them against wherever this is hosted rather than assuming a leading slash - a project page on GitHub Pages sits at a subpath.
